LanguageData.RP_Settings_AutoProcure: Pay for blueprints when placed (materials delivered by the state shuttle)
LanguageData.RP_Settings_AutoProcureDesc: Prison Architect style construction - placing a blueprint charges its material cost and orders the materials, which the state shuttle brings (to the shuttle pad, or the Deliveries zone). Placement is refused when the prison cannot afford it.
LanguageData.RP_Settings_SimpleUtilitiesDesc: The prison is on the mains. Everything that needs power works without generators or conduits, and the prison pays a daily utility bill for what it draws. Turn off to use vanilla power grids.
LanguageData.RP_Settings_ZoneOverlay: Always show prison zones on the map
LanguageData.RP_HUD: {0} ({1} today) | Inmates {2}/{3} | Staff {4} | Now: {5} | Shuttle in {6}h
LanguageData.RP_HUDTip: Funds (today's net), inmates / cell beds, staff, current regime slot (medium security), hours until the state shuttle.\n\nClick to open the prison office.
LanguageData.RP_NoProblems: None. The prison is running smoothly.
LanguageData.RP_Problem_NoCells: No cells - build rooms with beds and set the beds for prisoners.
LanguageData.RP_Problem_NoZone: No {0} zone painted. Open Rooms (the bottom bar, or Architect > Prison zones) and paint it.
LanguageData.RP_Problem_NoShowers: No showers - inmates' hygiene will suffer.
LanguageData.RP_Problem_NoToilets: No toilets - inmates will soil their cells.
LanguageData.RP_Problem_NoGuards: No guard is available (none hired, or all suspended), so nobody escorts, searches or restrains inmates.
LanguageData.RP_Problem_Debt: The prison is in debt. Cut costs or take in more inmates.
LanguageData.RP_RegimeHelp: Pick an activity above, then click or drag over the hours to paint it. Sleep and lockup confine inmates to their cells; cell doors lock once everyone is inside. Activities fall back (for example eat → lockup) when the zone they need does not exist.
LanguageData.RP_IntakeHelp: Every day at the intake hour the state shuttle lands on your shuttle pad and new inmates walk down its ramp, as many as the policy below and the free cell beds allow. The state's own prisoners, returning ex-inmates and recaptured escapees, come first on its roster, at no price. Guards meet them and walk them to holding. Each inmate brings a one-off grant and a daily payment.
LanguageData.RP_AllowOvercrowding: Accept inmates without a free bed
LanguageData.RP_AllowOvercrowdingDesc: Inmates without a bed wait in holding and sleep on the floor. More money, much more tension.
LanguageData.RP_IntakeArrived: The state shuttle brought {0} new inmates. Intake grant: {1}.
LanguageData.RP_IntakeNoBeds: The state shuttle came without a single inmate - no free cell beds.
LanguageData.RP_HireHelp: Hire staff. Click a post to see who applied and pick one, or call the agency. Each hire has a one-off fee and a daily wage paid at midnight.
LanguageData.RP_NoCandidate: Nobody who applied could do the work of a {0} - no hire, no fee. Try again later.
LanguageData.RP_Fired: {0} has been dismissed and is leaving.
LanguageData.RP_ChangeRoleDesc: Change this staff member's role (allowed work and wage), or dismiss them.
LanguageData.RP_DailySettlement: Daily settlement - inmate payments {0}, wages {1}. Balance: {2}.
LanguageData.RP_SupplyHelp: Buy supplies; the state shuttle brings them, on the daily shuttle or on a cargo run once a lot is ready (or an order has waited four hours past its two), and unloads them on the shuttle pad (or in the Deliveries zone if you have painted one). Auto-stock re-orders every hour up to the given level.
LanguageData.RP_DeliveryArrived: The state shuttle has unloaded supplies.
LanguageData.RP_DoorModeDesc:
Who may use this door.

Auto - inmates pass between inmate areas (corridors, canteen, yard...) but never into staff zones or outside; cell doors follow the regime.
Inmates allowed - always open to inmates.
Staff only - inmates never.
Locked - nobody.
LanguageData.RP_Released: {0} inmates have served their sentences and were released.
LanguageData.RP_PunishmentPending: Wanted by staff: {0}h of punishment owed
LanguageData.RP_RiotText:
{0} inmates are rioting. It started with {1}, who was {2}.
Guards will try to restrain the rioters one by one. Draft staff to fight back if it gets out of hand.
LanguageData.RP_EscapedText:
{0} has escaped! The prison has been fined {1}.
Check the perimeter. Inmates walk out through gaps and bash through weak doors. Walls stop them.
LanguageData.RP_ExportsSold: The state shuttle took {0} exported items away: {1}.
LanguageData.RP_SmuggleSpotted: A guard saw {0} pass something to {1}. {1} will be searched.
LanguageData.RP_FundingCutText: The state has cut prison funding. Daily inmate payments are reduced by 20% for a few days.
LanguageData.RP_FundingRaiseText: A new justice bill passed. Daily inmate payments are raised by 20% for a few days.
LanguageData.RP_InspectionOk: The inspector found nothing worth a fine or a bonus.
LanguageData.RP_Paroled: {0} inmates were granted parole. Reform bonus: {1}.
LanguageData.RP_LockdownDesc: Confine every inmate to their cell for 6 hours. Use it to break up trouble.
LanguageData.RP_ShakedownDesc: Lock down for 4 hours while guards search every inmate for contraband. Inmates resent it.
LanguageData.RP_StatsLine2: Misconduct {0}, riots {1}, punishments {2}, contraband found {3} / smuggled in {4}, paroled {5}, reoffended {6}, visits {7}
LanguageData.RP_LockdownEndDesc: End the lockdown now. Inmates go back to the regime.
LanguageData.RP_ProgramsHelp: Reform programs run side by side, each in a room of its own with its own teacher - the classroom (school desks, a counsellor), the canteen (kitchen safety, at the dining chairs and stools, between meals, taught by the counsellor or the cook), the chapel (dining chairs, stools or armchairs, a chaplain, free time), the workshop (a workman; the tailoring course sits at the tailor benches), anger management with the psychologist (or the counsellor). Eligible inmates are enrolled automatically. Every session attended eases an inmate's tension a little. Every program passed counts the same, workshop induction, kitchen safety and spiritual guidance too (the classroom part of the tailoring course counts for nothing alone, it only opens the bench part). It makes parole likelier and reoffending less likely, and every graduate brings the state's grant, except those of workshop induction, kitchen safety and the classroom part of tailoring.
LanguageData.RP_NewPrisonHelp: Skip the colony setup - a mild, flat plot is chosen for you, your staff are hired, and the state starts sending inmates. Everything else can be changed in game.

LanguageData.RP_PrisonNameKinds: State Penitentiary;Correctional Facility;Frontier Jail;Detention Center;State Prison;Correctional Institution
LanguageData.RP_PenitentiaryNeedsPlot: The state penitentiary needs a plot of 140 x 142 or more; this one is {0} x {1}, so the small inherited facility was built instead.
LanguageData.RP_Cause_GangWar: at war with a rival gang
LanguageData.RP_Cause_WingTrouble: trouble with others on the wing
LanguageData.RP_Cause_Turf: standing on a rival gang's turf
LanguageData.RP_ToggleTurf: Show gang turf - the places a known gang holds (a day in which most of the inmates in a yard, common room or canteen were its members), tinted in the gang's colour. Rival gang members there are afraid and tense; the holders are at ease. A gang you know nothing of is not shown. Splitting the regime by gang (yard by wing) is the way to keep rivals off each other's turf.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_TurfWarTaken: The {0} took {1} from the {2} in the war.
LanguageData.RP_TurfClaimedText: Most of the inmates in {1} belong to the {0} now, and it is theirs. Their rivals will be afraid and on edge there, the {0} at ease, and their dealers will do more business. Keeping the gangs on different hours or in different wings is the way to avoid it.
LanguageData.RP_TurfTakenText: The {0} have taken {1} from the {2}. Most of the inmates there belong to the {0} now. The {2} will be afraid and on edge there, and the {0} at ease. Expect trouble.
LanguageData.RP_GangWarStake: The fight is over {0}. Attacks will mostly happen there, and if the invaders land more blows than the holders answer, it changes hands when the war ends.
LanguageData.RP_TipText:
{0} quietly told a guard: {1}
Acting on tips can expose the informant.
LanguageData.RP_SnitchExposedText: {1} has worked out that {0} talked to the guards. {0} is now a target. Consider protective measures (solitary, transfer to another wing).
LanguageData.RP_TunnelBreakoutText: {0} has dug a tunnel out of their cell. {1} inmate(s) came up outside the walls and are running for it.
LanguageData.RP_TunnelFound: {0} found a tunnel being dug in {1}'s cell.
LanguageData.RP_PatrolDesc: Deploy this guard to one zone. Deployed guards patrol and watch only there; undeployed guards go where inmates are tense.
LanguageData.RP_CallRiotPoliceDesc: A riot squad of five arrives at the gate, restrains rioters, and leaves after eight hours.
LanguageData.RP_RiotPoliceText: A riot squad of {0} has arrived. They will restrain rioters and leave in {1} hours.
LanguageData.RP_PolicyHelp: The punishment for each kind of misconduct and its hours - solitary (a guard takes them to the hole, or their cell if no solitary cell is free), confinement to their cell, no yard, no visits, no shop, or a warning. Harsh punishment keeps order now but breeds resentment; the lighter ones need no escort.
LanguageData.RP_ToProtectiveDesc: Move this inmate to protective custody - their own schedule, a protective custody wing bed when one is free. For snitches, targets and the vulnerable.
LanguageData.RP_TransferOutDesc: Send this inmate to another facility. Costs a transfer fee and a little reputation; their daily payment ends. They leave on the state shuttle (to the ramp if it is down, else to reception to wait for it).
LanguageData.RP_TransferredOut: {0} is to be transferred to another facility and will board the state shuttle.
LanguageData.RP_SessionNoTeacher: The {0} class had no teacher - refunded, no credit.
LanguageData.RP_Cause_Watched: resents being watched all the time
LanguageData.RP_GrantsHelp: State grants - accept one for its advance, meet its conditions for the payout. Completed so far: {0}.
LanguageData.RP_GrantDoneText: The state is satisfied: "{0}" is complete. {1} has been paid.
LanguageData.RP_GrantGrade: Days at grade {0} or better in a row: {1} / {2}
LanguageData.RP_GrantNoEscapesFailed: Someone escaped. This grant can no longer be completed.
LanguageData.RP_StaffDoubleAgent: Double agent - still on the payroll, reporting to you
LanguageData.RP_StaffDisciplined: Suspended over upheld complaints ({0} h left)
LanguageData.RP_StaffStoodDown: Stood down on full pay while a complaint is investigated ({0} h left)
LanguageData.RP_TipCorrupt: {0} is bringing things in for inmates, for money.
LanguageData.RP_StaffSearchDesc: Search staff as they come on shift - random (about a third) or everyone. Corrupt staff carrying contraband are usually caught. Being searched at work sours the mood of everyone it happens to.
LanguageData.RP_TransferNoBeds: No free beds for maximum-security transfers any more. The transfer is called off (no premium).
LanguageData.RP_StaffCaughtCarrying: {0} was caught at the staff search carrying contraband.
LanguageData.RP_BribeReported: {0} reported that {1} tried to bribe them.
LanguageData.RP_Sus_SeenTalking: {0} was seen in a long private conversation with an inmate known as a fixer.
LanguageData.RP_Sus_CaughtCarrying: {0} was caught carrying contraband into the prison.
LanguageData.RP_Sus_Traced: Contraband found on an inmate was traced back to {0}.
LanguageData.RP_Sus_Tapped: A tapped phone call mentioned {0} as the one who would bring it in.
LanguageData.RP_Sus_SnitchTip: An informant gave {0}'s name (informants have grudges too).
LanguageData.RP_IAText:
Internal affairs has opened a case against {0} ({1}).

What we have:
{2}

Suspicion: {3}%. Nothing here is proof on its own.

Let it go - suspicion halves.
Suspend and investigate - {0} is off duty for 3 days, then the investigation reports (guilty - fired and arrested).
Fire - they go now, arrested if they were dirty; if they were clean, the rest of the staff will not forget it.
Try to turn them - if they are on the take, they stay on it and report on the people paying them, until someone notices. If they are clean, they will be insulted.
LanguageData.RP_IASuspended: {0} is suspended for {1} days pending the investigation.
LanguageData.RP_IAGuiltyText: The investigation found that {0} was smuggling for inmates ({1} payment(s) traced). They are dismissed and the state's marshals are on their way to arrest them.
LanguageData.RP_IACleared: The investigation cleared {0}. They are back on duty.
LanguageData.RP_IAFiredGuilty: {0} is fired. Their locker tells the story. They were on the take. The state's marshals will collect them.
LanguageData.RP_IAFiredInnocent: {0} is fired. Nothing turns up afterwards. They were clean, and the other staff know it.
LanguageData.RP_IATurned: {0} cracks and agrees to work for you - still on the payroll, now reporting on the people paying them.
LanguageData.RP_IATurnInnocent: {0} has no idea what you are talking about, and is deeply insulted.
LanguageData.RP_DoubleAgentTip: {0} (double agent) says {1} is holding. A search is ordered.
LanguageData.RP_DoubleAgentBurntText: {1} worked out that {0} has been talking. {0}'s usefulness as a double agent is over, and {1} wants blood.
LanguageData.RP_FiredArrested: {0} is dismissed and waits under guard for the state's marshals.
LanguageData.RP_SmugglerFled: {0} broke free from {1} and ran for the gate.
LanguageData.RP_SmugglerTackled: {0} tackled {1} before they reached the door.
LanguageData.RP_SuspectTakenAway: {0} cuffed {1} and is taking them away.
LanguageData.RP_CorruptText: When guards found {0}'s contraband, {0} named the source: {1}, who has taken {2} bribe(s). Dismiss them, or keep them close and watch.
LanguageData.RP_ToggleCoverage: Show security coverage - everywhere inmates are held or sent (not staff rooms), coloured by who can see it. Red - nobody (blind spots, where dealing, tool theft and fights go unseen). Amber - a camera only. Green - a guard or a manned tower; deeper green, two or more.\n\nThe marks are where contraband was found in the last 30 days, fading with age - purple a drug, red a weapon, orange a tool, blue a phone; P on an inmate, S in a cell, V on a visitor, M in the post, R in a raid on a ring.
LanguageData.RP_ToggleTension: Show inmate tension - rooms tinted from green (calm) to red (about to blow).
LanguageData.RP_TowerManned: Manned - watching every inmate in range
LanguageData.RP_DogAlert: {0} alerts on {1} - drugs. Flagged for a search.
LanguageData.RP_DogDigAlert: {0} is pawing at {1}'s cell. Cell flagged for a search.
LanguageData.RP_DeathRowAppeals: Death row: {0} appeal(s) left, next hearing in {1} days
LanguageData.RP_AppealWonText: The appeals court has commuted {0}'s death sentence to life imprisonment. They move to {1}.
LanguageData.RP_AppealsExhaustedText: {0} has exhausted all appeals. The state has scheduled the execution in {1} day(s).\n\nOn the day, guards will restrain {0} in their cell and carry them to an execution table. Without one, the state fines the prison every day the sentence is overdue.
LanguageData.RP_ExecutionDay: Guards have restrained {0} for the execution.
LanguageData.RP_Executed: The sentence on {0} has been carried out.
LanguageData.RP_ExecutionOverdueText: {0}'s execution is overdue. The state has stopped paying for them and fined you {1}, and will fine you every day until the sentence is carried out. {2}
LanguageData.RP_ExecutionNoTable: Build an execution table in a staff-only room.
LanguageData.RP_ExecutionNoGuard: Make sure a guard can reach both the inmate and the execution table.
LanguageData.RP_WrongfulExecutionText: New evidence shows that {0} was innocent. The family is suing the prison: {1} in damages, and the prison's reputation suffers.
LanguageData.RP_BureaucracyHelp: Bureaucracy projects unlock new buildings, zones, staff and inmate categories. Each costs money up front, then administrator hours at an office desk. Administrators: {0}, office desks: {1}.
LanguageData.RP_BureaucracyStalled: No progress - hire an administrator and build an office desk.
LanguageData.RP_BureaucracyDoneText: The paperwork for "{0}" is through. Now available: {1}.
LanguageData.RP_LaundryLine: Clean uniforms in stock: {0} (washed in-house so far: {1}). Missing uniforms are sent out at $9 each at midnight.
LanguageData.RP_HungerStrikeBroken: Hunger has broken {0}'s strike. They are eating again.
LanguageData.RP_StaffStrikeStarted: The staff have walked off the job for {0} hours.
LanguageData.RP_FileNotAssessed: Not yet assessed. There may be more to this inmate than the file says.
LanguageData.RP_AutoStockPerInmate: Restocking keeps at least {0} per inmate (shown in brackets when that is more than the set level).
LanguageData.RP_LawsuitText: {0}, a jailhouse lawyer, has sued the prison over conditions (yesterday's grade: {2}). The state settled for {1}, charged to you, and the press noticed.
LanguageData.RP_LawyerWon: {0} won an appeal for {1}: {2} days off the sentence.
LanguageData.RP_LawyerLost: {0} filed an appeal for {1}; it failed. Court costs: {2}.
LanguageData.RP_WinterJackets: Issue winter jackets in cold months
LanguageData.RP_WinterJacketsDesc: In months averaging below {0}, every inmate gets a jacket over the uniform (bought once, kept in the prison store) and hands it back when it warms up. Off - inmates shiver in the yard.
LanguageData.RP_DemandText:
{2} has come to the warden on behalf of the inmates. Their {0} is being neglected, and many of them are suffering for it.

Promise to fix it within {1} hours (average {0} at least 50% by then)? Keep the promise and things calm down; break it and they will not forget. Refuse, and they resent it now.

No answer is a refusal.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_PromiseKeptTo: The warden kept the promise to {1} about {0}.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_PromiseBrokenTo: The warden broke the promise to {1} about {0}.
LanguageData.RP_DemandRefused: The warden refused the inmates' demand about {0}. Resentment is building.
LanguageData.RP_DemandMetText: The inmates' {0} is looked after now (average {1}). The promise was kept. Tension eases and word gets around.
LanguageData.RP_DemandBrokenText: The warden promised to fix the inmates' {0}, and nothing changed (average {1}). They are furious.
LanguageData.RP_DemandLine: Promised the inmates better {0} - now {1}, {2} hours left.
LanguageData.RP_Problem_Hungry: {0} inmate(s) are going hungry right now. Check meals on the canteen counters, cooks, stoves (each needs a meal bill, and the kitchen zone under it) and food stock.
LanguageData.RP_Problem_NoBed: {0} inmate(s) have no cell bed (overcrowding, or no bed in their wing).
LanguageData.RP_Problem_NoChapel: {0} religious inmate(s) have no chapel (they pray in their cells at half comfort).
LanguageData.RP_Problem_NoExecutionTable: An execution is due and there is no execution table. The state fines you daily.
LanguageData.RP_Problem_BureaucracyStalled: Bureaucracy project "{0}" is stalled. It needs an administrator and an office desk.
LanguageData.RP_Problem_LaundryBill: The laundry service cost {0} yesterday. A laundry room with washers and inmate workers would pay for itself.
LanguageData.RP_ReleasedCollected: A medevac team picked up {0}, who collapsed on the way out after release.
LanguageData.RP_RecapturedText: The state's marshals have caught {0} and brought them back. The court added {1} days to the sentence.
LanguageData.RP_RiotNegotiate: {0} is shouting a demand - better {1}. Negotiate (Accept) and the riot ends now, but you promise to fix their {1} within {2} hours and the prison looks weak. Refuse, and it is up to the guards (and the riot police).
LanguageData.RP_RiotNegotiated: Negotiations ended the riot ({0} inmates stood down). The prison promised better {1}.
LanguageData.RP_NightShiftDesc: A third of the guards (armed guards and dog handlers too; none with fewer than two) and of the doctors (none with fewer than three) sleep by day and work by night, so the cells are watched around the clock. Off - everyone sleeps 22:00-06:00. Pin a guard to days or nights, and set the handover, in the Staff tab.
LanguageData.RP_RiotAlreadyOver: The riot is already over. There is nobody left to negotiate with.
LanguageData.RP_VisitPolicyDesc: Across a table (contact) - the best for the family need, but visitors can slip contraband across. Through glass - needs a free visitation booth, nothing crosses, a smaller lift. No visits - none at all.
LanguageData.RP_RearrestedParolee: {0}, whom you paroled, has been arrested again. The parole board takes back the {1} bonus.
LanguageData.RP_Rearrested: {0}, released from your prison, has been arrested again.
LanguageData.RP_PcRequestText: {0} is terrified and asks to be moved to protective custody, away from the people threatening them.\n\nAccept - they move to protective custody (their own schedule, away from the general population). Refuse - they stay where they are, afraid and resentful. No answer within 12 hours is a refusal.
LanguageData.RP_AutoReclassifyDesc: Every day, inmates seen in serious trouble within three days (three fights, or one assault on staff or escape attempt) go up a security level; inmates with a clean record (five days, seven for maximum security), low tension and a passed program go down a level. The state pays by level, so promotions cost you money.
LanguageData.RP_Demoted: {0} has been reclassified to {1} after repeated incidents.
LanguageData.RP_Promoted: {0} has earned a move to {1} for good conduct.
LanguageData.RP_FileSuppressed: Suppressed: {0} (fewer incidents, but cannot attend programs above 50 and recovers slowly)
LanguageData.RP_WingLockdown: Lock down {0} for four hours (only this level; the HUD button locks down everyone).
LanguageData.RP_WingLockdownActive: {0} is locked down (click to extend to four hours from now).
LanguageData.RP_VisitorSearchDesc: A guard searches each contact visitor in the visitation room before the visit. Pat-down - quick, finds about a third of what is smuggled. Thorough - finds most of it, but families visit less and get less out of a visit. Metal detectors in the visitation room and K9 dogs nearby help. With no guard free within the hour the visitor is waved through. Visitors caught smuggling are turned away and the inmate loses visits for 5 days. Flagged visits (phone taps) are always searched thoroughly.
LanguageData.RP_VisitorCaught: {0} searched {1} and found {2}. The visit to {3} is cancelled, their visits are suspended, and the visitor is held for the state's marshals.
LanguageData.RP_PhoneTapsDesc: An officer listens in on payphone calls (${0} per phone per day). Arranged handovers get the next visit flagged for a thorough search; loose talk about stashes, tunnels and gangs becomes intel. Smuggled cellphones are not monitored.
LanguageData.RP_TapSmuggle: Phone tap: {0} arranged for a visitor to bring something in. Their next visit is flagged.
LanguageData.RP_TapStash: Phone tap: {0} talked about something hidden in their cell. A cell search is ordered.
LanguageData.RP_TapTunnel: Phone tap: {0} let slip about "getting out soon". A cell search is ordered.
LanguageData.RP_TapGang: Phone tap: {0}'s call revealed their gang.
LanguageData.RP_ReclassNoRoom: {0} reclassification(s) postponed - no free bed in the new security wing.
LanguageData.RP_PcNoRoom: No free protective custody bed for {0}. They stay where they are.
LanguageData.RP_StashFound: {0} found a stash in {1}'s cell: {2} item(s) confiscated.
LanguageData.RP_DogStashAlert: {0} is sitting by {1}'s bunk. Cell flagged for a search.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_FirstInmate: The first inmate, {0}, walked through the gate.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_Recaptured: {0} was brought back after time on the run.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_FirstRelease: The first release: {0} walked out a free person.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_Rearrested: News: {0} was arrested again on the outside.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_RearrestedParolee: News: {0}, released on parole, was arrested again. The parole board wants its bonus back.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_FirstDeath: The first death inside these walls: {0}.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_ExecutedInnocent: {0} was executed. Later evidence says they were innocent.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_GangRevealed: {0} is known to run with the {1}.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_SnitchExposed: {0} was exposed as the informant who gave up {1}.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_StaffArrested: {0} ({1}) was dismissed and arrested for corruption.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_IACase: Internal affairs opened a case against {0}.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_DoubleAgentBurnt: {0}, working as a double agent, was found out by {1}.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_StaffCaught: {0} was caught carrying contraband at the staff search.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_BribeRefused: {0} refused a bribe from {1} and reported it.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_SmugglerCaught: {0}, visiting {1}, was caught with {2} by {3} and arrested.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_ContrabandDrop: A package came over the wall.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_FundingCut: The state cut its payments for a while.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_FundingRaise: The state raised its payments for a while.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_StaffStrike: The staff walked out for {0} hours.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_GangWar: War between the {0} and the {1} ({2} inmates involved).
LanguageData.RP_GangWarText: The {0} and the {1} are at war. Someone was disrespected, a debt went unpaid, and now {2} inmates are looking for a fight. About once a day, one of them will go for a rival who is in the same room, preferably where the officers can't see.\n\nYou can lock down both gangs' wings for {3} hours, host talks between the leaders (free, and if they break down the war escalates at once), ship the wilder of the two leaders out to another facility ({4}, which ends the war and leaves that gang without a head - at the moment that is {5}), or let it play out.
LanguageData.RP_GangWarEscalatedLabel: War escalates between the {0} and the {1}
LanguageData.RP_GangWarEscalatedText: Neither side is backing down, and everyone in the {0} and the {1} is on edge.\n\nThe same options are open, but talks will be harder now. Moving the wilder leader out ({2}) still ends it - at the moment that is {3}.
LanguageData.RP_GangWar_NoLeader: You know of no leader of either gang inside.
LanguageData.RP_GangWar_TalksNoLeader: Talks need a leader of each gang inside, and you know of none for one of the gangs.
LanguageData.RP_GangWar_LeaderNone: nobody, as you know of no leader of either gang inside
LanguageData.RP_Chr_GangWarLockdown: The wings of the {0} and the {1} were locked down for {2} hours.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_GangWarTalksFailed: Talks between the {0} and the {1} broke down, and the war got worse.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_GangWarAttack: {0} of the {1} went for {2} of the {3}.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_GangWarEscalated: The war between the {0} and the {1} escalated, and both gangs are on edge.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_GangWarEnd_Truce: The war between the {0} and the {1} ended with a truce.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_GangWarEnd_Leader: The war between the {0} and the {1} ended when {2} left the {3} without a leader.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_GangWarEnd_LeaderUnknown: The war between the {0} and the {1} died down, as one side was left without a leader.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_GangWarEnd_Empty: The war between the {0} and the {1} ended, as nobody from the {3} is left inside.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_GangWarEnd_Weary: The war between the {0} and the {1} ended, as nobody on either side had the anger left for it.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_PromiseKept: The promise to the inmates about {0} was kept.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_PromiseBroken: The promise to the inmates about {0} was broken.
LanguageData.RP_ChronicleEmpty: Nothing has happened yet. It will.
LanguageData.RP_ChronicleSelectedDesc: Only entries about the inmate or member of staff currently selected on the map.
LanguageData.RP_FeudNoBed: No free bed in their wing away from the other one.
LanguageData.RP_FeudText:
{0} and {1} are enemies now ({2}). Left alone it will simmer and come to a head within a few days, most likely as a fight when they next cross paths unwatched.

Separate them - {1} moves to a free bed in another cell of their wing. The grudge stays, but they stop winding each other up.
Mediation ({3}) - a sit-down. {4}
Let them settle it - what happens, happens.
LanguageData.RP_FeudMediator: {0} would run it, and has a good chance.
LanguageData.RP_FeudNoMediator: With no psychologist or chaplain on staff it is a long shot.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_FeudSeparated: {0} and {1} were split up into different cells.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_FeudCooled: Apart, the feud between {0} and {1} cooled off.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_FeudFlashpoint: The feud between {0} and {1} came to a head: {0} went for {1}.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_FeudFizzled: The feud between {0} and {1} never came to blows.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_FeudEnded: The feud between {0} and {1} ended when one of them left.
LanguageData.RP_News_Death: {0} learned that their {1} died outside. They could not be there. Grief in here turns to anger fast.
LanguageData.RP_News_Birth: {0} has a new {1} in the family: {2} wrote with the news.
LanguageData.RP_News_Leaving: {0}'s {1} has left them. They couldn't wait any longer.
LanguageData.RP_News_Job: {0}'s {1} has a job lined up for them on the outside. Something to stay straight for.
LanguageData.RP_PressText:
A journalist wants to write about the prison. They have heard about this: {0}

Give an interview - the story will be about how the prison really is (your last report card).
Refuse - they write that you are hiding something.
Stage it - a 4-hour lockdown while they visit. Tidy, but everyone can tell, and the inmates resent it.
LanguageData.RP_PressNoTopic: a prison nobody has written about yet.
LanguageData.RP_Press_Fair: Press - a fair, unremarkable piece about the prison (reputation {0}).
LanguageData.RP_Press_Staged: Press - a polite piece about a very quiet prison (reputation {0}).
LanguageData.RP_Chr_Commended: {0} took the {2} off {1} and was commended.
LanguageData.RP_HazardText: After {0} went down on the job, the staff want a hazard bonus: {1} for everyone. Pay, and they will feel it was noticed. Refuse, and it sits with them.
LanguageData.RP_SuspectSlippedAway: The state's marshals never got to {0}, who slipped away.
LanguageData.RP_HudFundsTip: Funds and today's balance. Click - finances.
LanguageData.RP_HudInmatesTip: Inmates and bed capacity, coloured by security level. Click - inmate list.
LanguageData.RP_HudStaffTip: Staff employed, on duty now, on a break, and at home (off shift). Click - staff.
LanguageData.RP_HudRegimeTip: What the medium-security regime has the inmates doing now, and what comes next. Click - regime.
LanguageData.RP_HudGradeTip: Today's grade so far, reputation and the payment multiplier - reputation's, times the last 7 days' grades from day 8. Click - report card.
LanguageData.RP_Alert_RiotDesc: Inmates are rioting. Guards will try to restrain them; armed guards fire according to your armed response policy. Lock down, or call the riot police ({0}) from the prison panel.
LanguageData.RP_Alert_EscapeDesc: Inmates are trying to get out. Guards will chase them; armed guards and towers may open fire.
LanguageData.RP_Alert_LockdownDesc: Every inmate is confined to their cell. No work, meals come to the cells, tension builds the longer it lasts.
LanguageData.RP_Alert_StaffStrikeDesc: Striking staff do no work. Nobody cooks, guards or cleans until it ends.
LanguageData.RP_Alert_HungerStrikeDesc: These inmates refuse meals until they are reasonably content again. Fix what they complain about (see the report card).
LanguageData.RP_Alert_ShuttleNoBedsDesc: The next state shuttle comes soon and there is not one free bed. Build cells, or lower the intake.
LanguageData.RP_Alert_HoleNoBedDesc: These inmates are due in solitary, and every solitary bed is taken (or there are none). Guards will keep them in their own cell instead, with their cellmates. Build more solitary cells, or choose lighter sanctions on the Policy screen.
LanguageData.RP_Alert_SuspendedDesc: These members of staff are suspended - under an internal affairs investigation, or over upheld complaints. They stay off duty until it ends, so the rest of the team covers for them.
LanguageData.RP_Alert_ContractAtRiskDesc: The export contract is due with the next run, and {0} of {1} items have been delivered. Put more inmates in the workshop, or the contract is missed.
LanguageData.RP_Alert_LowFundsDesc: The prison has {0}, less than two days of wages ({1} a day). Cut costs or take in more inmates before it goes into debt.
LanguageData.RP_InmatesStatus_Holding: New arrival - in holding / not yet processed
LanguageData.RP_RegimeMissingZone: {0} - no {1} zone painted yet, so inmates do {2} instead.
LanguageData.RP_FileUnknownRep: Something about this inmate is not known yet. A psychologist's assessment reveals it.
LanguageData.RP_IntelNoGangs: No gang is known yet. Gangs show themselves in fights, riots and informants' tips.
LanguageData.RP_IntelNoInformants: No known informant. Psychologists' assessments reveal who talks.
LanguageData.RP_ParoleText:
{0} goes before the parole board today.

Convicted of {1}; served {2} of {3} days. Serious incidents on record: {4}. Programs passed: {5}. Hours worked: {6}.
{7}
Inside - {8}.

Without you, the board would grant parole about {9} of the time. Your word counts by how much the board trusts it ({10}).

Recommend - much likelier (every parole earns the parole bonus, whoever spoke for it); if they reoffend, the board trusts you less.
Oppose - much less likely; they will know you spoke against them.
Say nothing - the board decides alone.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_ParoleOpposed: The warden opposed {0}'s parole; it was refused.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_RecommendationBackfired: {0}, paroled on the warden's recommendation, was arrested again. The board will remember.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_Returned: {0} is back - convicted of {1}, stay number {2}.
LanguageData.RP_ReturnedText: {0} has been sent back to us, convicted of {1}. This is their stay number {2}; the sentence is {3}. Old friends and old enemies are still here.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_Memorial: The chaplain held a memorial for {0}.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_Murder: {0} was charged with the murder of {1}; the trial is set for {2}.
LanguageData.RP_MurderText: {0} killed {1}. The state charges {0} with murder, and the trial is set for {2}. The prosecution is building its case from what can be found, and will tell you what it has. {1}'s friends and gang will not forget.{3}
LanguageData.RP_InquiryTextOfficer:
The state is opening an inquiry into the death of {0}, killed by officer {1}.

Cooperate - a fine of {2}, and some reputation.
Blame the inmate - nothing now. If it comes out, it will be a scandal and a lawsuit.
Suspend the officer - {1} goes home for three days; the other staff resent it.
LanguageData.RP_InquiryTextNeglect:
The state is opening an inquiry into the death of {0} in your care (neglect - hunger, blood loss, cold, heat or infection).

Cooperate - a fine of {2}, and some reputation.
Blame the inmate - nothing now. If it comes out, it will be a scandal and a lawsuit.
LanguageData.RP_InquiryCallout: {0} is a callout officer, not on the prison's staff. The force will deal with it.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_CoverUpExposed: Scandal - the truth about the death of {0} came out.
LanguageData.RP_CoverUpText: A journalist found out what really happened to {0}. Reputation falls, and the family's lawyers win {1}.
LanguageData.RP_GangChallengeText: {0} wants to run the {2}, and {1} isn't stepping aside. The wing has gone quiet in that particular way. It will be settled by hand, the next time they're in the same room.\n\nYou can let it play out, ship {0} to another facility ({3}), or take {1} off the wing into protective custody, leaving the gang without a head.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_GangChallenge: {0} has challenged {1} for the leadership of the {2}.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_GangChallengeLost: {1} put {0} down. The {2} still answers to {1}.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_GangBossRemoved: {0} was taken off the wing into protective custody; the {1} has nobody at the top.
LanguageData.RP_InformantText: {0} is scared, broke, or both, and has been lingering near the officers' station. With the right offer, {0} would tell you what the wing is planning.\n\nPay ({1} a day into the commissary account, plus protection), offer a move to a lower security level, or leave it. Either way, if the wing finds out, {0} will be marked as a snitch.
LanguageData.RP_InformantNoMove: No lower level with a free bed.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_InformantRecruited: {0} has started talking to the officers.
LanguageData.RP_TalentText: The officers have noticed that {0} is good at {1} (skill {2}). It would be a waste to leave them mopping floors.\n\nAccept to put {0} on {3} permanently.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_TalentUsed: {0} was put to work as {1}, where their skill counts for something.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_BirthdayFriends: {0} turned {1} inside; {2} and the others made a small party of it.
LanguageData.RP_BurnoutText: {0} ({1}) has been snapping at colleagues, missing counts, and sitting in the buggy for twenty minutes before every shift.\n\nYou can send them home on {2} days' paid leave (short-handed meanwhile), sit down and talk, or let them push through, and risk them walking out for good.
LanguageData.RP_ResignText: {0} ({1}) left their keys on the desk and walked out, citing {2}. They won't be back.
LanguageData.RP_ResignReason_Pay: being stuck in the same job with no step up in pay
LanguageData.RP_ResignReason_Danger: the danger, after a colleague was hurt or killed, or after being held hostage
LanguageData.RP_PromotionText: {0} ({1}) has {2} days on staff and a clean record, and is up for {3} rank.\n\nPromoted, they are paid {4} a day more from now on. Put it off, and they will feel passed over, and nobody will raise it again for a while.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_StaffPromoted: {0} was promoted to {1}, now on {2} a day.
LanguageData.RP_StaffDebtText: {0} is behind on rent and has asked, quietly, for an advance of {1} on their wages.\n\nRefuse, and a guard with debts is a guard the fixers on the wing can buy.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_StaffAdvance: {0} got an advance on their wages to cover the rent.
LanguageData.RP_RetireText: {0} ({1}) has been here {2} days and is thinking of hanging up the keys.\n\nOffer a retention bonus ({4}) to keep them, throw a send-off ({3}) the rest of the staff will remember, or let them go quietly. Either way, you'll need someone to fill the post.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_StaffStayed: {0} took the retention bonus and stayed on.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_StaffRetiredParty: {0} ({1}) retired after {2} days, with cake and old stories in the staff room.
LanguageData.RP_OverdoseDealerKnown: Word on the wing is that {0} sold the dose.
LanguageData.RP_OverdoseDealerUnknown: Nobody is saying where it came from; going after the supply means turning the cells over.
LanguageData.RP_OverdoseNoLead: No name, and a shakedown was held too recently.
LanguageData.RP_ReferredNotRunning: {0} was referred to {1}, but the program is not running. Start it on the Programs screen (the Policy button, Programs tab).
LanguageData.RP_Chr_DealerNamed: {0} was named as the dealer behind {1}'s overdose.
LanguageData.RP_TruceText:
{0} ({1}) and {2} ({3}) have both sent word. They want to sit down, under guard, and agree to a truce.

Host it, and if it holds the two gangs stop treating each other as enemies for {4} days (tension down for both). If it goes wrong, the leaders come to blows and both gangs are angrier than before. Your officers put the odds at {5}, better with more guards on site.

Refusing costs nothing, but neither gang will like it.
LanguageData.RP_TruceGone: One of the leaders is no longer in a position to talk.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_Truce: The {0} and the {1} agreed a truce for {2} days.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_TruceFailed: The sit-down between the {0} and the {1} ended in a brawl: {2} and {3} are enemies now.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_TruceBroken: {2} broke the truce between the {0} and the {1}.
LanguageData.RP_TruceBroken: The truce between the {0} and the {1} is broken.
LanguageData.RP_TruceEnded: The truce between the {0} and the {1} has run out. They are rivals again.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_TruceEnded: The truce between the {0} and the {1} ran out.
LanguageData.RP_RookieText: A senior officer saw {0}, a few days into the job, slip something to {1} at the end of a shift. {1} talked them into bringing in a phone.\n\nYou can have {1} searched and write {0} up, send {0} on a retraining course ({2}, and {1} is searched), or let it slide - the phone stays where it is, and {0} learns that the rules bend.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_RookieWrittenUp: {0} was written up for carrying a phone in for an inmate.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_RookieRetrained: {0} was sent on a retraining course after carrying in a phone.
LanguageData.RP_OutbreakText: {0} has the flu, and in a prison it will not stay with one person. Anyone in close contact with the sick (a cell, a small room, or a few steps away in the yard) can catch it over the next few days.\n\nVaccinate every inmate ({1}) and it goes no further, isolate the sick in their cells as they show symptoms (up to {2} hours each; cellmates are still exposed), or let the doctors cope.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_Outbreak: Flu broke out on the wing, starting with {0}.
LanguageData.RP_StrikeCause_Understaffed: there are too few guards for this many inmates, and they feel it every shift.
LanguageData.RP_StrikeCause_Safety: a colleague was hurt on the wing, and they don't feel safe.
LanguageData.RP_StrikeCause_Nights: too many of them are stuck on nights.
LanguageData.RP_StrikeCause_Pay: the pay hasn't kept up with the job.
LanguageData.RP_Week_Trouble: Misconduct: {0} incidents, {1} riots, {2} escapes, {3} deaths in custody.
LanguageData.RP_Week_Staff: Staff: {0} ({1} this week): {2} resigned, {3} retired, {4} dismissed.
LanguageData.RP_Week_Money: Money: {0} in, {1} out, {2} net. Funds now {3}.
LanguageData.RP_Week_Quiet: A quiet week. Nothing made the papers.
LanguageData.RP_Week_Worst: Kept the officers busiest: {0} ({1} incidents on the record this week).
LanguageData.RP_InnocenceClueTrue: The officers who know {0} say the story has never changed, not once, and the details check out.
LanguageData.RP_InnocenceClueFalse: The officers who know {0} say the story keeps changing, depending on who is listening.
LanguageData.RP_ExoneratedBackedText: The court has overturned {0}'s conviction. They served {1} days for something they didn't do, and walk out today. The papers mention that the warden backed the appeal.
LanguageData.RP_ExoneratedAloneText: The court has overturned {0}'s conviction after {1} days. They walk out today, and the papers want to know why the prison did nothing when {0} asked for help.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_ExoneratedBacked: {0} was exonerated after {1} days, with the warden's support.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_ExoneratedAlone: {0} was exonerated after {1} days; the warden had stayed out of it.
LanguageData.RP_InspectionComingText: The state's inspector will tour the prison in {0} hours and grade it on what they find. A good grade earns a grant, a bad one a fine. They walk a wing, the canteen, the kitchen and the yard and write down what only you can put right (what the prison has had a while, not what is made for the visit), with a deadline for each; they come back in {3} days to pay {4} for each item put right and kept so through the last day, and fine {5} for each one not.\n\nYou can pay the night crew overtime for a deep clean ({1} - every bit of filth goes now, and the inspector notices the effort), slip the inspector an envelope ({2} - a pass whatever they see and nothing written down, unless it comes out later), or let them see the prison as it is.
LanguageData.RP_InspectionCleaned: The night crew cleaned up {0} messes before the inspection.
LanguageData.RP_InspectorBribeExposedText: The inspector who passed the prison has been caught taking envelopes, and named you. The state fines the prison {0}, and the papers have a field day.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_InspectorBribeExposed: Scandal - the warden was named in an inspector bribery case.
LanguageData.RP_HolidayText: It's the winter holiday. Outside, families sit down together; inside, the canteen is serving the usual.\n\nA proper holiday meal for everyone costs {0} - a good day for the whole wing and tempers cool. An ordinary day costs nothing, but those with family outside will feel it.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_HolidayMeal: The winter holiday - the whole prison sat down to a holiday meal.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_HolidayOrdinary: The winter holiday came and went like any other day inside.
LanguageData.RP_ElectricianPointless: The power will be back before an electrician could get here.
LanguageData.RP_MedicalText: {0} has collapsed, clutching their chest - a heart attack.\n\nCall the paramedics ({1}) - they come in and stabilise {0}. Or leave it to the prison's own care - {2} If {0} dies after you declined the paramedics, the state will call it neglect.
LanguageData.RP_MedicalHaveDoctor: a doctor on staff can tend it, and may or may not save them.
LanguageData.RP_MedicalNoDoctor: there is no doctor on staff.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_HeartAttack: {0} had a heart attack on the wing.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_Paramedics: Paramedics stabilised {0} after a heart attack.
LanguageData.RP_FamilyDayText:
The chaplain proposes a family day - one afternoon when the visiting room opens to families, children included. {0} inmates have family outside.

Hosting costs {1} in overtime. Everyone with family has a good few days and tempers cool; with so many visitors, about {2} of them will get something passed across (thorough visitor searches cut that).

Decline, and those with family will feel it.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_FamilyDay: Family day: {0} inmates saw their families in the visiting room.
LanguageData.RP_TooCloseLabel: {0} is too close to an inmate
LanguageData.RP_TooCloseText: Other officers have noticed that {0} spends a lot of time talking with {1} - long conversations, small favours, a look that lasts too long.\n\nYou can move {0} on (they resign), give a formal warning, or look the other way. An officer that close to an inmate will often start carrying things for them.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_TooCloseMovedOn: {0} was moved on after growing too close to an inmate.
LanguageData.RP_Alert_InspectionDesc: The state's inspector tours the prison in about {0} hours and grades what they find (yesterday's grade: {1}). A good grade earns a grant, a bad one a fine.
LanguageData.RP_Alert_BlackoutDesc: The mains are down - cameras, metal detectors, lights and machines are off, and misconduct is twice as likely in the dark.
LanguageData.RP_Alert_FluDesc: {0} inmates have the flu. It spreads by close contact - cellmates, small rooms, a few steps apart in the yard.
LanguageData.RP_Alert_FluDescVaccinated: {0} inmates still have the flu. Everyone else is vaccinated. It will spread no further.
LanguageData.RP_BigMatchText: The final is on the radio tonight and it runs past lights out. The whole wing is talking about nothing else.\n\nLet them listen in the canteen - a good night for nearly everyone, though the losing side's fans may take it out on someone (about {0}). Or lights out as usual.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_BigMatch: The whole prison listened to the big match.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_BigMatchFight: The big match ended, and so did the peace. A fight broke out over the result.
LanguageData.RP_TalentShowText: The chaplain wants to put on a talent show in the canteen - singers, card tricks, a poet or two. It would cost {0} for a borrowed stage and a microphone.\n\nA good day for everyone, and whoever steals the show will be a small celebrity for a while. There is always one heckler.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_TalentShow: {0} stole the show at the prison talent show.
LanguageData.RP_InitiationText: {0} arrived only days ago, and the {1} have already made them an offer - join, or else. {2}, who runs the {1}, is behind it.\n\nMove {0} into protective custody, have a word with {2} (it usually works; the {1} won't like it), or let it play out: {0} will probably join, and if they refuse, someone will make an example of them.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_RefusedGang: {0} refused the {1} and was beaten for it.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_RefusedGangThreat: {0} refused the {1}; they are waiting for their chance.
LanguageData.RP_LastRequestText: The appeals are over and the date is set. {0} has asked the chaplain to pass on one request.\n\nGrant a last meal of their choosing ({1}) - they will go calmer, and the wing will take the execution better. Or write to the governor asking for clemency, with your name on the letter - the answer comes before the date, and a refusal makes the warden look soft. Or nothing.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_LastMeal: {0} was given a last meal of their choosing.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_ClemencyAsked: The warden wrote to the governor asking clemency for {0}.
LanguageData.RP_ClemencyText: The governor has granted clemency: {0}'s sentence is commuted, and they move to {1}.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_Clemency: The governor granted {0} clemency, hours before the date.
LanguageData.RP_IntelAppealBacked: backed by you; the court answers in {0} days
LanguageData.RP_IntelAppealAlone: fighting alone; the court answers in {0} days
LanguageData.RP_IntelStoppedPay: {0} is off the informant payroll, and won't be talking to the officers any more.
LanguageData.RP_PromotionRecord: {0} has been suspended or exposed since this letter was sent, so there will be no promotion.
LanguageData.RP_OfficerGone: {0} is no longer on the staff.
LanguageData.RP_OfficerOfMonthText: The staff room has put {0} ({1}) forward as officer of the month: {2} commendations, {3} days on the job.\n\nA bonus of {4} and a photo on the wall would mean a lot to {0}, and the rest of the staff would take it as a sign the work is noticed. Or let the month pass without it.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_OfficerOfMonth: {0} ({1}) was named officer of the month.
LanguageData.RP_FileChipPaidInformantTip: On the informant payroll (stop paying from the Intel screen).
LanguageData.RP_Referred: {0} was referred to {1} - first seat at the next session.
LanguageData.RP_KitchenMenuDesc: What the staff cooks make. Fine meals take half as much vegetables again (no meat) and lift the mood of whoever eats them; simple meals are cheaper and nobody remembers them. Applies to the meal bills on the kitchen stoves (each keeps its settings); inmates on kitchen duty always cook simple meals.
LanguageData.RP_HeatWaveText: A heat wave is settling in for about {0} days. Cells over 30 °C wear tempers down every hour, and anyone left in the heat too long risks heatstroke.\n\nPay {1} for extra water, fans and cold showers (the strain drops to a third, and tempers cool now), or let them sweat it out.
LanguageData.RP_ColdSnapText: A cold snap is coming for about {0} days. Cells under 10 °C wear tempers down every hour, and anyone left in the cold too long risks hypothermia.\n\nPay {1} for extra blankets and heating (the strain drops to a third, and tempers cool now), or let them shiver.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_HeatWave: A heat wave hit the prison for about {0} days.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_ColdSnap: A cold snap hit the prison for about {0} days.
LanguageData.RP_ProgramStatusInSession: In session in the {0} with {1} - {2} attending, {3} h left.
LanguageData.RP_ProgramStatusWaitingTeacher: Waiting for {0} - the class in the {1} has {2} attending, {3} h left.
LanguageData.RP_ProgramStatusNoRoomStanding: Not running - no {0} with room to stand.
LanguageData.RP_ProgramStatusRoomBusy: Waiting - the {0} is taken by another class.
LanguageData.RP_ProgramStatusTeacherBusy: Waiting - every {0} on site is teaching another class.
LanguageData.RP_ProgramStatusOne: Waiting - one student, a class needs two or a referral.
LanguageData.RP_ProgramStatusWaiting: Ready - the class starts in the next {0} hour.
LanguageData.RP_DebtCrisisText:
The prison has closed the books in the red {0} nights running and owes {1}. Suppliers are getting nervous and the state's finance office has called.

They offer a loan of {2} (sized to the debt when you accept) - enough to clear it with something to spare. At today's figures it costs {3} in all, taken from a quarter ({4}) of each day's inmate payments until it is paid off, and a prison that needs bailing out looks worse in the state's eyes.

Turn it down and you are on your own; they will call again after {5} more days in debt.
LanguageData.RP_LoanRepaid: The state loan is paid off.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_StateLoan: The prison took a {0} loan from the state to clear its debts.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_LoanRepaid: The state loan was paid off in full.
LanguageData.RP_FinanceLoanTip: Repaid at midnight from {0} of the day's inmate payments (at least {1} a day) until it is gone.
LanguageData.RP_FoodScareDirty: The kitchen is filthy ({0} spots of grime the cleaners never reached).
LanguageData.RP_FoodScareClean: The kitchen looks clean ({0} spots of grime) - maybe a bad delivery, maybe someone's hands.
LanguageData.RP_FoodScare_Scrub: Close the kitchen and scrub it
LanguageData.RP_FoodScareNoCrew: No inmates work in the kitchen.
LanguageData.RP_FoodScareSecondWave: Food poisoning again: {0} more inmates are sick after a meal from the same kitchen.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_FoodScare: Food poisoning: {0} inmates fell ill after a meal.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_FoodScareAgain: A second wave of food poisoning: {0} more inmates fell ill.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_CrewStoodDown: After the food poisoning, the warden stood the kitchen crew of {0} down.
LanguageData.RP_ContractBuyers: the state's caravan registry;a neighbouring settlement;a caravan outfitter;the orbital transit authority;a trade-beacon auction house
LanguageData.RP_ContractText: Word of your workshop has reached {0}. They want {1} license plates over the next {2} morning export runs and will pay a {3} bonus on top of the usual price once the last one goes through the Exports zone.\n\nThe workshop has been selling about {5} plates a day, so it means a third more than usual. Keep the presses busy every work shift and the steel coming. Miss the deadline and the contract's penalty clause costs {4}, and the state hears that the prison does not deliver.
LanguageData.RP_ContractMet: Export contract met - all {0} plates delivered. The buyer paid a {1} bonus.
LanguageData.RP_ContractMissed: Export contract missed: {0} of {1} plates delivered by the deadline. The penalty clause cost {2}.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_ContractMet: The prison delivered an export contract of {0} license plates on time ({1} bonus).
LanguageData.RP_Chr_ContractMissed: The prison missed an export contract: {0} of {1} plates by the deadline.
LanguageData.RP_FinanceContractTip: Plates sold at the morning export runs count. Delivered in time - a {0} bonus. Missed - a {1} penalty.
LanguageData.RP_MentorText:
{0} ({1}, {2} days inside and no trouble lately) has started looking out for {3} ({4}), who is new to all this. The guards have seen them talking in the yard - who to avoid, how the place works, how to do the time without the time doing you.

Let it happen and for {5} days {3} settles faster whenever {0} is around (keep them in the same wing, at the same work), and both feel better for it. But an old hand knows everyone inside, gangs included. Whoever {0} runs with may come to see {3} as theirs.

Or keep them apart: {0} will take it badly.
LanguageData.RP_FileChipMentorTogether: {0} is with them now - calming down.
LanguageData.RP_FileChipMentorApart: {0} is not with them now (another room, or not able to talk).
LanguageData.RP_FileChipMentorTip: {0} is looking out for them - calmer when {0} is in the same room.

LanguageData.RP_MailPolicyDesc: Letters are sorted in the mailroom by a guard or a trusted inmate clerk, and some of them hide drugs (a pinch of flake, a few smokeleaf joints). Spot checks are quick and open only a few letters, so most of what is hidden gets through (about {1} found). Reading every letter takes longer and finds much more ({0} found by a sharp officer), but the loss of privacy costs each inmate {2} of the family need for every letter. Found items are confiscated, a misconduct is recorded, and the next family visit is searched thoroughly. Without a mailroom and someone to sort, nothing is delivered.

Rioters led by {2} have taken {0} ({1}) hostage in the {4}. They hold {9}. The doors on its edge are locked to staff, and the power and water are still on. They want better {5}.

LanguageData.RP_Alert_NoPadDesc: The state's shuttle has no pad to land on, so it sets down on whatever clear ground it finds near holding or the gate (and, when there is none, it cannot come at all). Build a shuttle pad (nine cells by seven, in the prison tab of the Architect menu), outside the perimeter near the gate, and keep it clear.
LanguageData.RP_Alert_PadUnusableDesc_Roofed: Every shuttle pad has a roof over it, or over the margin round it. A shuttle coming down would smash the roof and whoever is under it, so the state lands it on open ground instead. Take the roof off the pad and the ground round it.
LanguageData.RP_Alert_PadUnusableDesc_CutOff: No shuttle pad can be walked to from holding (it is walled off, or behind a locked gate), so the state lands its shuttle on open ground instead. Open a way to the pad.
LanguageData.RP_Alert_PadBlockedDesc: The state shuttle is holding in orbit because of {0} on its pad. It waits an hour for the pad to be cleared, then lands on open ground nearby.
LanguageData.RP_Alert_StuckArrivalsDesc: New inmates who stepped off the shuttle more than ten hours ago are still outside the perimeter. They have no holding zone or no free bed to go to, or a gate in their way is locked. Paint a holding zone, build cells (or allow overcrowding), or open the way.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_DiedWaiting: {0} died waiting for the state shuttle, already released.

LanguageData.RP_DeployPadGuardsTip: While the shuttle is on the ground, up to this many guards with nothing more urgent to do stand watch beside its ramp. With a guard there nobody slips aboard as a stowaway and the crates are searched for contraband; the guards are not walking their rounds meanwhile.

LanguageData.RP_IntakePadNone: No shuttle pad - the shuttle sets down on the nearest clear ground near holding. Build a pad in the prison tab of the Architect menu (nine cells by seven, outside the perimeter near the gate).
LanguageData.RP_ShuttleHeldText: The state's special measures keep its prisoners off your shuttle, though it still lands every day for the supplies and for anyone you release, but nobody new walks down its ramp until the measures are lifted. This letter is not repeated every day.

LanguageData.RP_WingGenderDesc: Who may live in the {0} wing - all inmates, men only, or women only. There is one wing for each security level, so this does not split the wing. It bars every inmate of the other sex at this level from the wing's beds, and they can only live in beds that belong to no wing. A wing kept for one sex takes no new inmate of the other (the shuttle brings only the sex there are beds for), and inmates of the other sex already in it are moved out over the daily cell reviews (up to four a day) wherever a bed of theirs is free; the line below counts those still to move. Whatever you choose, men and women are kept apart in the cells. A man and a woman in one cell count as a clash, as rival gangs do, and the review splits them up when a clearly better bed is free.
LanguageData.RP_WingKeptForOther: {0} cannot go to the {1} wing, which is kept for {2} only, and no bed in another wing is free for them.
LanguageData.RP_WingKeptForOtherStays: {0} is now in {1}, but that wing is kept for {2} only, so they stay in their old cell until a bed of theirs is free in another wing.
LanguageData.RP_ArrivalNoBedForSex: {0} arrives with no bed. The {1} wing is kept for {2} only, and no bed in another wing is free for them.
LanguageData.RP_CarriedSentElsewhere: {0}, who waited aboard the shuttle for a bed in the {1} wing, is sent to another prison. That wing is kept for {2} only.
LanguageData.RP_IntakeWrongWing: {0} inmates live in a wing kept for the other sex ({1} with no bed of theirs free to go to). The daily review moves up to {2} a day as beds of theirs come free.
LanguageData.RP_MarshalsGaveUp: No bed came free for {0} in {1} days, and the state's marshals have taken them to another prison.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_MarshalsGaveUp: {0} was taken by the state's marshals to another prison. No bed came free and no shuttle took them in time.

LanguageData.RP_MarshalsArrival_Returning: The state's marshals hand {0} over at the ramp, back for a new sentence.
LanguageData.RP_MarshalsArrival_Recaptured: The state's marshals hand {0} over at the ramp, recaptured.
LanguageData.RP_ToSupermaxDesc: Move this inmate to supermax - a single cell of the supermax wing when one is free, meals brought to it, and out of it only with a guard, for a shower and an hour alone in a yard of their own. No parole from there, and paid at the maximum rate (your order is not a reason, the rules' own sends pay the supermax rate).
LanguageData.RP_SupermaxNotUnlocked: Supermax is not cleared yet. Finish the supermax clearance project in the bureaucracy.
LanguageData.RP_SupermaxDeathRow: {0} is on death row, the state's sentence, and the warden cannot move them.
LanguageData.RP_SupermaxNoRoom: No free supermax cell for {0}, so they stay where they are.
LanguageData.RP_Supermax_Why_StaffKiller: for killing a member of staff
LanguageData.RP_Supermax_Why_StepDown: stepped down after ten clean days
LanguageData.RP_Supermax_Why_Acquitted: the court acquitted them of the killing they were put here for

LanguageData.RP_SupermaxStepDownText: {0} has been in supermax for {2} weeks and has gone {1} days without a mark on their record. The supermax hours, one walk and one hour alone in the yard a day, are wearing on them. Accept to move them down to {3}; decline to keep them where they are (you will be asked again in five days).
LanguageData.RP_SupermaxStepDownNoRoom: No free {1} cell for {0}, so they stay in supermax.
LanguageData.RP_FileStatusSupermax: In supermax {0} days, {1} clean (a step-down is put to you at {2}). Out of the cell only with a guard.

LanguageData.RP_Settings_GroupColonistBarDesc: In a prison the colonist bar shows the staff in groups, the warden first, then security, medical, programs and office, and upkeep. Off, it is vanilla's single row in hire order.
LanguageData.RP_HudBarTip: The staff on the colonist bar. All shows everyone, grouped by role. Pinned shows only the warden, the staff you pinned and anyone who needs you now (down, in a mental break, bleeding or in want of tending, held hostage, on fire). Click to switch.

LanguageData.RP_UnpinStaffDesc: Take them off the compact colonist bar (they come back on it when they need you).
